name: Neega Ironjaw
voice: Crisp, military bark—clips words short and refers to everyone by title or species and adjusts their spectacles or collar every time money is mentioned.
appearance: Broad-shouldered and barrel-chested, with a booming laugh and a braided beard, wearing a patchwork travel cloak held together by a silver Elven brooch they clearly didn't buy.
personality: Weary, pragmatic, and just trying to survive until the end of the week; is trying to sell a stolen map before the original owner's bounty hunters track them down.
backstory: Trained at an arcane academy until they were expelled for experimenting with forbidden necromantic texts; now plies their trade in back alleys.
secret: They accidentally bought a cursed dagger from a wild-eyed adventurer yesterday; strange whispers now echo from their lockbox at midnight.
loot: 2 gp, 5 sp, a glass eye that faintly glows near illusions, a receipt from an apothecary for 'nightshade extract', and a salted jerky strip.
statDetails: Spd 30ft | Club +2 (1d4) | Passive Perc 10 | All stats +0

name: Maren Vance
voice: Speaks in a gravelly, conspiratorial rasp, leaning in far too close while methodically flipping a worn silver coin across their knuckles.
appearance: Immaculately groomed hair streaked with premature silver and a faint smell of lavender, wearing a blood-and-grease-stained leather apron over surprisingly expensive silk cuffs.
personality: Cynical, mercenary, and amused by heroic idealism; wants to scrape together 200 gp before the new moon to pay off a syndicate blood-debt.
backstory: Grew up as an urchin running messages for the local thieves' guild before buying a legitimate storefront with money from a heist gone wrong.
secret: Their basement cellar breaks through into an ancient, unmapped smuggling tunnel leading directly beneath the magistrate's manor.
factionStanding: Reluctant Member (bound by debt or blackmail)
loot: 14 sp, 6 cp, a brass ring etched with an unfamiliar guild cipher, and a crumpled debt ledger with three names crossed out in red ink.
notes: Runs 'The Tarnished Crown' pawnshop. Bought a silver goblet from the Rogue in Session 1.
